xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherDisclosureWithRespectT:
This is in furtherance to our intimation dated March 31, 2026 with respect to allotment of inter alia 8,68,92,966 warrants (“Tranche I Warrants”) to Avenir Investment RSC Ltd (“Promoter”) by way of a preferential issue on a private placement basis, each carrying a right to subscribe to 1 (one) fully paid-up equity share of the Company having face value of INR 2.

In this regard, we wish to inform you that the Promoter has exercised their right for conversion of the Tranche I Warrants into an equivalent number of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company and paid the balance consideration of INR 905,85,91,705.50/- (Indian Rupees Nine Hundred and Five Crore Eighty Five Lakh Ninety One Thousand Seven Hundred and Five and Fifty Paise Only) (being the remaining 75% of the subscription amount for the Tranche I Warrants) to the Company. Accordingly, the Securities Issuance and Investment Committee of the Company, has today, i.e. on October 30, 2026, inter alia, considered and approved the allotment of 8,68,92,966 fully paid-up equity shares of the Company at an issue price of INR 139 per equity share to the Promoter by way of preferential issue on a private placement basis, pursuant to the conversion of Tranche I Warrants into equivalent number of fully-paid up equity shares of the Company, and the details of the allotment are set out below:

Name of Allottee - Avenir Investment RSC Ltd;
Category (Promoter/ Promoter group/ Non-promoter) - Promoter;
No. of convertible warrants held (prior to conversion) - 30,66,90,535 warrants;
No. of warrants applied for conversion - 8,68,92,966 warrants;
No. of fully paid-up equity shares allotted - 8,68,92,966 fully paid-up equity shares;
No. of warrants outstanding for conversion - 21,97,97,569 warrants*.

*The outstanding warrants may be exercised at any time, in one or more tranches, until expiry of 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment thereof, i.e. from March 31, 2026.

Pursuant to the aforesaid allotment, the shareholding of the Promoter in the Company has increased from 28.34% to 33.32% of the total number of equity shares of the Company. The Promoter continues to hold 21,97,97,569 warrants (“Remaining Warrants”), which may be exercised at any time, in one or more tranches, within a period of 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment thereof, i.e. on or before September 30, 2027. Upon exercise and conversion of all the Remaining Warrants, and assuming no other change in the share capital of the Company, the shareholding of the Promoter in the Company shall increase to 43.28% of the total number of equity shares of the Company post such conversion.

Consequent to the aforesaid allotment, the paid-up equity share capital of the Company stands increased to INR 2,49,88,92,046.71 divided into 1,24,84,36,597 fully paid-up equity shares having face value of INR 2 each bearing ISIN INE148I01020 and 30,13,213 partly paid-up equity shares having a face value of INR 2 each (INR 0.67 paid-up) bearing ISIN IN9148I01010.

The equity shares so allotted shall rank pari passu with the existing equity shares of the Company in all respects and will be listed on BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, in accordance with applicable law.
